result.rationale: In embeddable-host.js.es6, categoryId is initialized to null and is only set in the edit() action. The save() flow always calls host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId'))), which for a first-time save (categoryId null, server substitutes SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id in EmbeddableHostsController#save_host) would return undefined, clobbering the category from the server response and rendering a blank category badge per the template's {{category-badge host.category}}. The mechanism described is consistent with the diff.

judged_text: The save handler overwrites host.category with Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')), which returns undefined when no category was chosen, discarding the category the server actually assigned in its response. The first-use flow (add host, type a hostname, save without picking a category — cantSave only requires the hostname) renders the saved row with a blank category badge even though the server stored Uncategorized, and re-editing it shows an empty chooser until a full page reload.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action sets `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, but `categoryId` is initialized as `null` and `cantSave` only checks `buffered.host` (hostname) and `host.isSaving`, so saving without selecting a category is allowed. On success it then does `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')));`. When no category was chosen, `findById(null)` will yield `undefined`, overwriting `host.category` even though the server (`Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host`) assigns `uncategorized_category_id` when `category_id` is blank. The template renders `{{category-badge host.category}}`, so this client-side overwrite can produce a blank category display despite the server having stored a valid category.
